name: Orano
desc: French state-controlled nuclear fuel cycle group covering uranium mining, conversion, enrichment, recycling, nuclear logistics and dismantling.
products: uranium mining, conversion and enrichment, spent-fuel recycling, nuclear logistics, decommissioning, engineering; Orano Med cancer therapies
minority_investors: Japan Nuclear Fuel Limited 5%, Mitsubishi Heavy Industries 5%
marketing_autonomy_basis: operates as its own SA with own brand
markets: France, Canada, Kazakhstan, Niger, United States, Mongolia, Uzbekistan; utility customers worldwide
expansion_markets: United States (Project Ike enrichment plant, Oak Ridge, Tennessee); Mongolia; Uzbekistan
distress: Niger junta took operational control of subsidiary Somaïr (Dec 2024); arbitration ongoing

signals.what: uranium deal with Mongolian government for Zuuvch-Ovoo deposit
USD 900m US DOE award; plans c. USD 5bn Project Ike enrichment facility in Oak Ridge, Tennessee

fit_rationale: State nuclear-fuel group building a USD 5bn US enrichment plant and courting utilities and governments; hospitality at US, Japanese and European races could support customer and political relationships, but brand sensitivity is high.
f1_markets: France (no race), United States, Japan, Canada
compliance: Wikipedia says Orano has maintained business relationships in Russia despite international sanctions; Niger dispute; nuclear brand sensitivity
outstanding: marketing head; check Russia relationships before approach

name: Gasunie
desc: Dutch state-owned gas infrastructure company operating more than 17,000 km of pipelines in the Netherlands and northern Germany, plus storage and LNG terminals.
products: gas transmission, gas storage (Zuidwending), LNG terminal stakes (Gate terminal 42.5%), BBL pipeline, hydrogen and heat networks, green gas certificates (Vertogas)

name: Inter Pipeline
desc: Calgary-based energy infrastructure company running oil sands and conventional oil pipelines, NGL extraction plants and, through Inter Terminals, European bulk-liquid storage.
products: oil sands pipelines (Cold Lake, Corridor), conventional oil pipelines, NGL extraction, bulk liquid storage terminals
customers: oil sands producers, shippers, storage clients
